primary_engine: yosys-smtbmc/Z3, depth 4, complete base plus induction; 28 original assertions, zero assumptions

verifier_correction.finding: A candidate input init attribute can restrict original initial inputs in the synchronous product, making an unsafe original appear proved. Reproduced with an unsafe first-cycle flag assertion: original CEX, v1 gate SAFE.
verifier_correction.fix: Restrict nontrivial init attributes to real stored state, reject conflicting state initializers and asynchronous memory read resets.
verifier_correction.regression: tests.test_native_abstraction.test_input_init_cannot_hide_a_real_initial_counterexample passes after fix; original v1 evidence retained in robustness-init.
verifier_correction.experiment_policy: Keep snapshot-v1 and all generation ledgers immutable. Every provisionally accepted full-AI candidate must be checked by snapshot-v2 before final acceptance. No candidate bytes or failed attempts are repaired. Generation budget is unchanged. Record v2 revalidation cost separately.
verifier_correction.timing_policy: Select each task winner by the smallest v1 total candidate verification wall time among candidates accepted by v2, not by the fastest property alone. Then repeat the frozen winner and matched normalized baseline serially three times using v2. Mark pilot development measurements as exploratory; final timing runs have no competing local formal/build/test tasks.
